preconditions.description: The number of votes is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Each vote contains between 1 and 26 unique teams, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(votes[i]) == len(votes[j]) for all 0 <= i, j < len(votes)
preconditions.description: All votes are of the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(char.isupper() and char.isalpha() for vote in votes for char in vote)
preconditions.description: Each character in each vote is an uppercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all(set(vote) == set(votes[0]) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All teams in each vote are the same as the teams in the first vote.

postconditions.description: The returned value is a string containing all the teams in the order determined by the ranking system.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.count(team) == sum(vote.count(team) for vote in votes) for team in return_value)
postconditions.description: The frequency of each team in the returned value matches the frequency of that team in all the votes combined.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(team) <= return_value.rindex(team) for team in set(return_value))
postconditions.description: Teams that are tied for the same positions are ordered consecutively in the returned value.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(team) < return_value.index(next_team) for i in range(len(return_value) - 1) for team in return_value for next_team in return_value[i+1:])
postconditions.description: The returned value is sorted according to the ranking system, with ties broken alphabetically.
